mapper.sql: SELECT task_id, task_no, task_name, rule_id, rule_name, rule_version_no, target_desc, deadline, task_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_safety_rule_learn_task
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' AND task_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskNo}, '%') AND task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%') AND rule_id = #{ruleId} AND rule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ruleName}, '%') AND task_status = #{taskStatus}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_safety_rule_learn_task (task_no, task_name, rule_id, rule_name, rule_version_no, target_desc, deadline, task_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{taskName}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleName}, #{ruleVersionNo}, #{targetDesc}, #{deadline}, #{taskStatus}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_safety_rule_learn_task task_name = #{taskName}, rule_version_no = #{ruleVersionNo}, target_desc = #{targetDesc}, deadline = #{deadline}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.sql: SELECT learn_id, task_id, rule_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, sign_status, sign_time, sign_ip, sign_terminal, exam_score, is_pass, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark FROM biz_safety_rule_learn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_safety_rule_learn (task_id, rule_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, sign_status, sign_terminal, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{ruleId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, '0', 'PC', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO biz_safety_rule_learn (task_id, rule_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, sign_status, sign_terminal, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.ruleId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.userName}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.deptName}, '0', 'PC', '0', #{item.createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_safety_rule_learn SET sign_status = '1', sign_time = sysdate(), sign_ip = #{signIp}, sign_terminal = #{signTerminal}, exam_score = #{examScore}, is_pass = #{isPass}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE learn_id = #{learnId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE biz_safety_rule_learn l JOIN biz_safety_rule_learn_task t ON l.task_id = t.task_id SET l.sign_status = '2', l.update_time = sysdate(), t.task_status = '2' WHERE l.sign_status = '0' AND l.del_flag = '0' AND t.task_status = '0' AND t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.deadline < CURDATE()

UPDATE biz_safety_rule_learn_task t SET t.task_status = '1', t.update_time = sysdate() WHERE t.task_status IN ('0','2') AND t.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_safety_rule_learn l WHERE l.task_id = t.task_id AND l.sign_status = '0' AND l.del_flag = '0') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_safety_rule_learn l2 WHERE l2.task_id = t.task_id AND l2.del_flag = '0')
mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id, t.task_no, t.task_name, t.rule_id, t.rule_name, t.rule_version_no, t.target_desc, t.deadline, t.task_status, t.create_by, t.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_safety_rule_learn l WHERE l.task_id = t.task_id AND l.del_flag = '0') AS remark FROM biz_safety_rule_learn_task t WHERE t.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
